release.summary: Verse map follow-ups. Automatic painting waits while the map covers the picture, so turning pages with it open paints nothing behind it; closing it paints the verse then in view once. On a short phone map the place card opens compact, so the chapters before and after show without a scroll: the place chips on one sideways-scrolling row with the chosen place's site, then ‹ before · after › on one row (long references shortened, link names keep what shows and the whole reference), and the full list's link. A swipe across the chips does not turn the page. The card steps aside on a phone while Ask is open. Rivers run to the map's edge (bible-map-outline.json rebuilt with clipLine). The card moved to place-card.tsx, chapter order compares (book, chapter) pairs, and one MapExploration type serves the map and analytics. Spec #556's body now says chapters.
